    // Any 2D affine map is projective (third column becomes 0, 0, 1).
    Transform2D(a: AffineTransform2D): Transform2D {
        var m = a.Matrix;
        return Transform2D(Matrix3x3(
            Number3(m.Row1.X, m.Row1.Y, 0.0),
            Number3(m.Row2.X, m.Row2.Y, 0.0),
            Number3(m.Row3.X, m.Row3.Y, 1.0)));
    }

    // Apply the homography: lift to homogeneous coordinates, map, and divide
    // by the resulting weight. Precondition: the point is not mapped onto the
    // line at infinity (weight is non-zero).
    Transform(p: Point2D, t: Transform2D): Point2D {
        var m = t.Matrix;
        var v = m.Row1 * p.X + m.Row2 * p.Y + m.Row3;
        return (v.X / v.Z, v.Y / v.Z);
    }

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): t * p.
    Multiply(t: Transform2D, p: Point2D): Point2D
        => Transform(p, t);

    // The homography that applies `first`, then `second` (row-vector product).
    Compose(first: Transform2D, second: Transform2D): Transform2D
        => Transform2D(first.Matrix * second.Matrix);

    // Alias for Compose, enabling the * operator: a * b applies a first.
    Multiply(a: Transform2D, b: Transform2D): Transform2D
        => a.Compose(b);

    // Any 3D affine map is projective.
    Transform3D(a: AffineTransform3D): Transform3D
        => Transform3D(a.Matrix4x4);

    // Apply the homography: lift to homogeneous coordinates, map, and divide
    // by the resulting weight. Precondition: the point is not mapped onto the
    // plane at infinity (weight is non-zero).
    Transform(p: Point3D, t: Transform3D): Point3D {
        var v = Number4(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, 1.0).Transform(t.Matrix);
        return (v.X / v.W, v.Y / v.W, v.Z / v.W);
    }

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): t * p.
    Multiply(t: Transform3D, p: Point3D): Point3D
        => Transform(p, t);

    // The homography that applies `first`, then `second` (row-vector product).
    Compose(first: Transform3D, second: Transform3D): Transform3D
        => Transform3D(first.Matrix * second.Matrix);

    // Alias for Compose, enabling the * operator: a * b applies a first.
    Multiply(a: Transform3D, b: Transform3D): Transform3D
        => a.Compose(b);

    //==
    // # Elementary transforms
    //
    // The single-purpose transforms of `transforms.types.plato` — translation,
    // scaling, reflection, and the about-a-centre forms. Each one names what it
    // does instead of hiding it in a matrix, and each converts into the affine
    // transform of its dimension (its `IAffine2D` / `IAffine3D` obligation), which
    // is where transforms of different kinds are composed.

    //==
    // Translations — a rigid shift. A translation moves positions but not
    // displacements, so its action on a vector is the identity.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Translation_(geometry)

    // The translation as an affine map (identity linear part).
    AffineTransform2D(t: Translation2D): AffineTransform2D
        => AffineTransform2D(Matrix3x2.CreateTranslation(t.Vector));

    // Shift the point by the translation's displacement.
    Transform(p: Point2D, t: Translation2D): Point2D
        => p + t.Vector;

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): t * p.
    Multiply(t: Translation2D, p: Point2D): Point2D
        => Transform(p, t);

    // A translation does not act on displacements.
    Transform(v: Vector2D, t: Translation2D): Vector2D
        => v;

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): t * v.
    Multiply(t: Translation2D, v: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => Transform(v, t);

    // The translation that undoes this one (the opposite displacement).
    Inverse(t: Translation2D): Translation2D
        => Translation2D(-t.Vector);

    // The zero translation.
    Identity(_: Translation2D): Translation2D
        => Translation2D(Vector2D.Zero);

    // The translation as an affine map (identity linear part).
    AffineTransform3D(t: Translation3D): AffineTransform3D
        => Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(t.Vector).AffineTransform3D;

    // Shift the point by the translation's displacement.
    Transform(p: Point3D, t: Translation3D): Point3D
        => p + t.Vector;

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): t * p.
    Multiply(t: Translation3D, p: Point3D): Point3D
        => Transform(p, t);

    // A translation does not act on displacements.
    Transform(v: Vector3D, t: Translation3D): Vector3D
        => v;

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): t * v.
    Multiply(t: Translation3D, v: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => Transform(v, t);

    // The translation that undoes this one (the opposite displacement).
    Inverse(t: Translation3D): Translation3D
        => Translation3D(-t.Vector);

    // The zero translation.
    Identity(_: Translation3D): Translation3D
        => Translation3D(Vector3D.Zero);

    //==
    // Scalings about the origin — per-axis and uniform. Unlike a translation a
    // scaling is linear, so it acts on displacements as well as positions.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scaling_(geometry)

    // The per-axis scaling as an affine map.
    AffineTransform2D(s: Scaling2D): AffineTransform2D
        => AffineTransform2D(Matrix3x2.CreateScale(s.Amount));

    // Scale the point's offset from the origin per axis.
    Transform(p: Point2D, s: Scaling2D): Point2D
        => (p.PositionVector * s.Amount).ToPoint;

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): s * p.
    Multiply(s: Scaling2D, p: Point2D): Point2D
        => Transform(p, s);

    // Scale the displacement per axis.
    Transform(v: Vector2D, s: Scaling2D): Vector2D
        => v * s.Amount;

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): s * v.
    Multiply(s: Scaling2D, v: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => Transform(v, s);

    // The reciprocal scaling. Precondition: no component of Amount is zero.
    Inverse(s: Scaling2D): Scaling2D
        => Scaling2D(Number2(1.0 / s.Amount.X, 1.0 / s.Amount.Y));

    // The unit scaling.
    Identity(_: Scaling2D): Scaling2D
        => Scaling2D(Number2.One);
